badge.$description: Non-interactive display pill — the sportsbook's status/label chips (live, freebet, postponed, bet statuses, expiry, generic tags). One axis on top of size: 'role' (5 semantic states — neutral/active/positive/negative/warning), each in 'tint' (12% wash + coloured text, the common label look) or 'solid' (saturated fill + contrasting text). Reworked from the old decorative 10-hue 'tag' version: sportsbook labels carry meaning, so Badge is driven by the semantic role/label/status colours, not arbitrary hues. Bet-settlement statuses and named labels (live/freebet/…) are shown on the docs page as applications of these roles + the label/betStatus semantic colours, not as extra token structure. Split deliberately from Chip (the interactive filter-toggle) — display pill vs. checkbox-like toggle are different ARIA roles.

size.$description: Height/paddingX/label ladder mirrors Counter's own sm/base/lg so the two small-pill components line up at identical heights in a row.

role.$description: 5 semantic states. 'neutral' uses the raised surface (no coloured wash) with secondary/default text. Solid text is dark (text.forActiveBg) on the bright fills (active/warning) and white (text.onFill) on the darker fills (positive/negative) — the per-theme label-text problem a future text.forLabelBg will formalise.
